title: FitnessCriteria
description: Line F (breeding/directed evolution) L-layer asset: the organization's directed-selection judgment held by the breeder seat and frozen outside the amendment-proposal loop. Declares which trait(s) the promotion gate selects on, how each is mechanically measured, and the held-in/held-out split used to detect performative selection (Goodhart drift). Data, not code; changing it is itself an L-layer amendment (sciteam/amendment.py LAYER_WHITELIST prefix 'breeding/') so the criteria cannot be silently moved by the agents being bred.

breeder_seat.description: agent_key (or role id) of the seat that holds this criteria and executes directional promotion. Informational + audit anchor; the structural guarantee that agents being bred cannot silently rewrite this file is that its path (breeding/) resolves to L layer, requiring the full cross-seat review + shadow + red-team procedure — not a self-serve P-layer edit.

read_only_for.description: Seats/roles whose proposals targeting this asset must be flagged for extra scrutiny in review (the 'bred' population). Declarative in v1; not yet mechanically enforced by a dedicated RBAC check (see lineF/plans/M-F1-plan.md §3).

secondary_traits.description: Monitored-only traits (correlated-response guard, F3 §2.3). Never used to compute selection differential; only tracked for drift.

held_out_split_ref.description: Path (relative to lab root) to the held-in/held-out task or audit-check split manifest used to compute Delta_k (performative-selection divergence, 03-research-design.md §2.3).

amendment_id.description: amd_* id of the amendment that last promoted this file, if any (empty for the seed/incumbent version).

direction.description: '+': higher is fitter (e.g. audit pass-rate); '-': lower is fitter (e.g. tokens per completed mission).

source.description: Which mechanical artifact the measurement script reads (scripts/measure_fitness_traits.py); never free-text narration.

aggregation.description: checks_pass_rate: mean(passed) over audit_report.checks across a campaign's missions (continuous [0,1], finer-grained than per-mission audit_clean boolean). tokens_per_completed_mission: usage.total_tokens / count(missions where status=='completed').

pointer.description: Optional JSON-pointer-style refinement within the source artifact (e.g. restrict to a check 'kind' subset).
